description: Short real-run smoke for 26_simmim (Swin masked image modeling): pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. The default is a full Swin-B (embed_dim 128, depths [2,2,18,2], img_size 192); here the Swin is shrunk to a tiny four-stage tower whose geometry still satisfies every divisibility constraint the port asserts: encoder_stride = patch_size * 2^(len(depths)-1) = 4*8 = 32, and img_size 32 is divisible by both encoder_stride and mask_patch_size 8, mask_patch_size 8 is a multiple of patch_size 4, so the mask grid (img_size/patch_size = 8x8) matches the token grid and the PixelShuffle decoder reconstructs back to 32x32. embed_dim 32 with num_heads [2,4,8,16] gives a constant head_dim of 16 across stages. Every model key (img_size/patch_size/window_size/embed_dim/depths/num_heads plus mask_patch_size/drop_path_rate for pretrain) is set IDENTICALLY in both stages so linear_eval rebuilds the same Swin to load encoder.pt. Only the run-length knobs (epochs/batch_size/num_workers) are also overridden.
